frequency_question: How often do central bank boards implement or raise macroprudential capital buffers above zero when economic conditions permit within a multi-year horizon?
membership_rule: Includes major central banks with a formal countercyclical capital buffer framework operating under Basel III standards from 2010 to 2026. Excludes jurisdictions without active macroprudential mandates.

cases.name: Reserve Bank of New Zealand activation 2018

coverage_note: 6 named hits; 1 named miss representing the Federal Reserve's specific historical baseline.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller emerging market jurisdictions with less comparable institutional structures.
skeleton: Global peer central banks with active CCyB frameworks establishing non-zero buffers during normal or expansionary financial cycles.
multiplier: 7 total major policy cycles evaluated across developed market central banks; 6 instances of non-zero activation/increase, 1 instance of permanent zero maintenance by the Federal Reserve.
validity_reason: Basel III capital framework rules and macroprudential mandates remain stable through the decade.
